column1: # Hand labels for the toy fixture: the repo-level dependencies a person reading `repos/` says
# are real. One edge per line, five tab-separated fields:
#   requiring repo, providing repo, identity kind, identity key, scope
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# Judgements a reader of the repos makes that the toy convention cannot:
# - pad-fork also publishes `left-pad`, but nothing uses it: app and ui-kit use lib-pad's.
# - web/deps.toy has CRLF line endings; web still uses ui-kit.
# - app requires analytics-sdk, which no fixture repo provides: no edge.
